en.title: Longest Segment Convertible to the Corresponding String Within Budget
en.description:
s and t have equal length and contain only lowercase letters. The cost of changing s[i] to t[i] is the absolute difference of their ASCII codes. Find a contiguous interval whose total position-by-position conversion cost is ≤K, and return the maximum interval length; return 0 if no non-empty interval qualifies.

The ranges added by this site for missing bounds and the recovery of source typos are described in the input protocol.
en.input: The input is a JSON array [s,t,K]. The original has no numeric bounds; this site adds 0≤|s|=|t|≤200000, 0≤K≤10^9; the total encoded input is ≤401000 bytes.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; 0; 0. They have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Treat the per-position costs as a non-negative array, and use two pointers to maintain the longest window whose total cost does not exceed K.
